PostToolUse.description: attio-upsert-company: upserts company data to Attio CRM after any tool use that produces company context
hubspot-upsert-contact: upserts contact data to HubSpot after any tool use that produces contact context
airtable-log-row: appends a row to an Airtable base with the tool use output

Stop.description: lemlist-push-sequence: pushes any leads identified in the session to a Lemlist sequence on task completion

Notification.description: slack-approval-alert: sends a Slack message requesting human approval when Claude raises a notification
